question: Does the short verbal architecture/product case predict independent design work?
inclusions: Independent comparator or outcome where applicable
exclusions: Inferring validation from challenge score alone
Familiar system-design scripts or stack knowledge explain the score; a written work sample predicts more.

selection_criteria: Record role, population, outcome, method and uncertainty
Separate vendor-reported claims from independent results
source_policy.conflict_handling: Keep competing findings and identify population or method differences before synthesis.
source_policy.freshness_rule: Recheck mutable legal, product and market sources at the relevant decision time.

stop_conditions: Prerequisite purpose, source or participant-data decision fails
Evidence or method cannot distinguish the primary rival explanation
limitations: No approved protocol or observed result for EA-RQ-07
Role, population and measurement precision remain to be selected
claim_ceiling: Candidate inquiry only; no collection, result, validity or employment claim.
